description: Free estimate for UK sole traders. Maps each expense to an HMRC Self Assessment self-employment (SA103F) expense category using simple keyword rules (no AI), with a confidence level, and flags items that are usually not allowable or need care (entertaining, everyday clothing, fines, private use, depreciation, capital items, mixed-use phone/car/home). Totals per category when amounts are given.
